name: Manuela Azevedo & Hélder Gonçalves
description: The iconic voices of Clã perform as part of the Porto Book Fair's opening night, offering a magical concert in a beautiful setting.
longDescription:
Manuela Azevedo and Hélder Gonçalves, two of the most recognizable voices from the acclaimed Portuguese band Clã, will perform a special concert as part of the opening night celebrations for the Porto Book Fair. This musical event highlights the fair's commitment to integrating various art forms, presenting a unique opportunity to hear these established artists in a different context. Their performance draws on their extensive careers, known for their distinctive vocal styles and contributions to Portuguese music.

Attendees can expect an evening concert set within the scenic Jardins do Palácio de Cristal. The outdoor setting provides a relaxed atmosphere for enjoying live music. The performance is designed to complement the literary focus of the Book Fair's inauguration, offering a cultural experience for a diverse audience interested in both music and literature. The duration of the concert will be typical for a headline performance.

This event is free to attend, welcoming all members of the public without prior booking. The Jardins do Palácio de Cristal are accessible via various public transport routes, including a short walk from the Palácio de Cristal bus stops. The venue is generally accessible, and families are welcome.
